summary_1line: Yudhishthira defeats Srutayush in fierce combat while other duels rage, including Chekitana and Kripa fighting with bows, mace, and swords until both collapse.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira, blazing with wrath like the sun at the end of the age, stands in his chariot as terrified warriors watch and the cosmos seems to tremble.
Chekitana leaps from his shattered chariot and swings a massive mace while Kripa on foot shoots arrows that shatter the weapon in midair.
Chekitana and Kripa rush at each other with gleaming sabres, striking until both warriors collapse together onto the dusty battlefield.
